Building and structures located on lands owned by or leased to federal, state or local governments.

Farm buildings. The construction, alteration, addition, repair, removal, demolition, use, location or maintenance of farm buildings. This provision does not exempt the owner from obtaining required electrical or plumbing permits nor from complying with all other applicable local and state regulations and Chapter 2, Definitions, of the International Building Code.
The term "farm buildings" is defined as follows:

column3: FARM BUILDING. A structure utilized to store farm implements, hay, feed, grain, or other agricultural or horticultural products or to house poultry, livestock, or other farm animals. Such structure shall not include habitable or occupiable spaces, spaces in which agricultural products are processed, treated, or packaged; nor shall an agricultural building be a place of occupancy by the general public."
